newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ECI Telecom started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ECI Telecom started.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Tim Savageaux has started coverage of ECI Telecom with a long-term attractive rating.

-- In a written statement, Savageaux said the Israel-based company, a maker of telecommunications equipment for European and Asian markets, is in an "excellent position" to provide broadband access and transport products.

-- Savageaux expects the company to earn $1.33 a share in 1996 and $1.67 in 1997, and he notes the company is trading at an "attractive" 12.1 times the 1997 estimate. Some comparable companies trade at 40 times earnings estimates.
